tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password. The endpoint should validate the email and password, and reject registration when the email is already in use. The endpoint should return a success message upon successful registration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the registration endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given an email that is already in use, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given an invalid email or password, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Store passwords using bcrypt hashing. Never store or log plaintext passwords. The password hashing should be integrated with the registration endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password, when it is hashed, then the hashed password is stored in the database.
Given a plaintext password, when it is logged, then an error is thrown.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry. The frontend attaches this token to subsequent authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then the token contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when it is attached to an authenticated request, then the request is authenticated successfully.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then the token is invalidated.
Given an invalidated token, when it is attached to an authenticated request, then the request is rejected.

tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints, as well as the password hashing and JWT token issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.

tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints, as well as the password hashing and JWT token issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
